name: Motorized Bicycle
description: Massachusetts's moped category: a pedal bicycle with a helper motor, or a non-pedal bicycle with a motor, with an automatic transmission and a top speed of no more than 30 mph. An e-bike that assists past 20 mph, or a pedal-less electric moped, lands here while it can't exceed 30 mph.

restrictions.rule: A pedal bicycle with a helper motor or a non-pedal bicycle with a motor, and an automatic transmission (Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1)
Capable of no more than 30 mph; the definition also caps an engine at 50 cc (Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1)
Not an electric bicycle (Class 1 or Class 2), and not a motor vehicle (Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1)
May not be ridden faster than 25 mph (Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1B)
Riders must be 16 or older and hold a valid driver's license or learner's permit; a learner's permit holder needs no accompanying driver (Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1B)
Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting the registrar's standards (Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1B)
Must comply with the federal motor vehicle safety standards that apply to it
The seller affixes a numbered RMV sticker or plate, renewed every two years
May use all public ways and bike lanes beside them, except limited-access or express state highways posted against bicycles (Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1B)
Barred from off-street recreational bicycle paths (Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1B)
